2609.07100.title: Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Transformer for Credit Card Fraud Detection
2609.07100.paper_summary: Credit card fraud detection typically relies on tabular features, while repeated attributes can also provide useful relational signals. This paper proposes THGT-FD, a Temporal Heterogeneous Graph Transformer for Fraud Detection. Each transaction is represented using one transaction token and six types of relation tokens and incorporates Time2Vec encoding into the transaction representation. A Transformer learns the interactions among these tokens within each individual transaction and then outputs a fraud probability. Experiments were conducted on 150,000 transactions sampled from the IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset and chronologically partitioned according to TransactionDT. On the test set, THGT-FD achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.8536, an average precision of 0.4164, and a Recall@5% of 0.4708. The class-weighted histogram-based gradient-boosting baseline achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.8722. The results indicate that relation tokens provide useful information for fraud-risk ranking, although the current model does not yet incorporate entity-level historical aggregation.
2609.07100.paper_summary_zh: 信用卡詐騙檢測通常依賴於表格特徵，而重複屬性也可以提供有用的關聯信號。本文提出了 THGT-FD，一種用於詐騙檢測的時間異質圖Transformer。每筆交易使用一個交易標記和六種類型的關係標記來表示，並將 Time2Vec 編碼納入交易表示中。Transformer學習這些標記在每個單獨交易中的互動，然後輸出詐騙概率。實驗是在從 IEEE-CIS 詐騙檢測數據集中抽樣的 150,000 筆交易上進行的，並根據 TransactionDT 按時間順序進行劃分。在測試集上，THGT-FD 實現了 0.8536 的 AUC-ROC，0.4164 的平均精度，以及 0.4708 的 Recall@5%。類別加權直方圖基於的梯度提升基線實現了 0.8722 的 AUC-ROC。結果表明，關係標記為詐騙風險排名提供了有用的信息，儘管當前模型尚未納入實體級的歷史聚合。
2609.07100.author: Qinwen Yan et.al.
